subject: Pilot payment lane and net terms / credit request
messages:

Subject: Request: pilot net terms extended to Net60 + PO attached

Hi Rishi / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to run the 3-week pilot. Procurement asked me to check whether we can be set up on Net60 for the pilot period; our internal cycle only clears invoices on a 60-day cadence. If Net60 is not possible, can we do a partial prepay + Net45?

Attached is our PO (Bionova_PO_45109.pdf) to kick things off — it references the pilot scope and expected consumption. I can also share our VAT certificate and vendor setup form if that helps accelerate the vendor onboarding.

Next steps from our side:
- Bionova will provide VAT cert + vendor form this week
- We can confirm billing contact for AP (cc'ed)

Let me know what you need from us to make Net60 happen or what compromise you can offer for the pilot.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Operations
Bionova Therapeutics

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bionova.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot net terms extended to Net60 + PO attached

Hi Elena — thanks for the PO and quick turnaround. We're keen to get Bionova running. A couple of notes from our side:

1) Net60 for new enterprise customers is atypical for Redwood for initial pilots — our standard is Net30 / Net45 depending on credit checks.
2) To accommodate longer payment windows, Finance usually requires either: a small upfront deposit (20–30% of estimated pilot spend) or a provisional credit hold (credit limit) tied to company financials and VAT evidence.
3) If you can provide the VAT certificate and vendor form this week, we can start vendor onboarding while Finance reviews the credit paperwork.

Proposed middle path: we can do Net45 for the pilot with milestone invoicing (Invoice 1: 20% upfront to confirm seat allocation; Invoice 2: remainder Net45). Alternatively, Net60 could be considered if Bionova agrees to a $60k provisional credit hold and monthly reconciliations.

Kimberly (cc) — can you confirm the specific documentation Finance needs to evaluate the provisional credit?

Elena — curious whether Bionova has used letter-of-credit or bank guarantee before for vendor terms? That would also expedite approval.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bionova.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood finance: documentation + credit packaging options

Hi Elena / Rishi,

Following up with Finance's formal note on options to support a longer payment lane for an initial pilot. We typically require the items below to assess a provisional credit hold:

Required documentation for credit review:
- Company registration / incorporation docs (PDF)
- VAT certificate (official) — required for EU entities
- Latest 3 months of bank statements or credit reference (redacted acceptable)
- Completed credit application (attached — credit_application_form.pdf)

Commercial options (pick one):
A) Net45 with milestone invoicing (recommended): 20% upfront, remainder Net45 after milestone acceptance.
B) Net60 with provisional credit hold: Finance sets a provisional credit limit (e.g., $60k) and invoices are Net60; monthly reconciliations required and Redwood reserves right to invoice early if threshold exceeded.
C) Net60 + bank instrument: tradeable alternative — Bionova provides a letter of credit or bank guarantee to support Net60 and we move forward without deposit.

I've attached a draft with the payment terms we use internally (Redwood_payment_terms_draft.pdf) and the credit application form. Time to decision: typically 3–5 business days after receiving the paperwork.

If Bionova prefers milestone billing, we can draft a simple 2-invoice schedule tied to pilot acceptance criteria (I can send a short SOW addendum).

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_payment_terms_draft.pdf; credit_application_form.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bionova.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@bionova.com
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood finance: documentation + credit packaging options

Hi Kimberly / Rishi,

Thanks — that's clear and helpful. We can provide the VAT certificate (attached) and the vendor onboarding form by tomorrow. Bionova's procurement team prefers not to prepay more than 20% for a pilot, but we can agree to milestone invoicing. A bank guarantee is possible, but that will add internal routing time; we could offer an internal letter confirming funding for the pilot if that helps.

Proposal from our side:
- Pilot month 1: Milestone invoice 1 = 20% upfront (to reserve capacity)
- Pilot month 2: Remaining invoiced Net60 with review at the end of month 2 to determine future cadence

Is Redwood able to accept a pilot sequence where the first invoice is upfront and the second is Net60 (with a commitment to move to Net45 once vendor checks complete)? If not, we are prepared to proceed with Net45 remainder.

Attached: Bionova_VAT_Certificate.pdf

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Operations, Bionova Therapeutics
Attachment: Bionova_VAT_Certificate.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bionova.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood finance: documentation + credit packaging options

Elena — thanks for the VAT cert and for proposing a pragmatic path. After speaking with Finance, we can offer the following compromise to get the pilot live ASAP:

Agreed terms for pilot (summary):
- Invoice 1: 20% upfront (due on receipt) to confirm seat allocation / capacity reservation.
- Invoice 2: Remaining balance invoiced Net45 from invoice date.
- For the first two months we will accept the Net60 request on a provisional basis ONLY if Bionova provides the bank confirmation letter (or a short internal funding confirmation) within 5 business days; otherwise Redwood's default will apply (Net45).
- Redwood will provisionally set a $60k credit corridor while we complete the credit application; finance reserves the right to reduce corridor if paperwork is not received within the agreed window.

Next steps:
1) Rishi to send a short SOW addendum and the DocuSign link for the two-invoice milestone schedule.
2) Elena to upload the completed credit application + bank/credit reference (per Kimberly's list).
3) Kimberly to confirm the provisional credit corridor in writing once paperwork is received.

DocuSign for the SOW/milestone invoice schedule: https://www.docusign.com/tx/3a9f-Redwood-Bionova-sign (Redwood_DocuSign_Authorization_link.txt)

If that works, I'll send the SOW addendum this afternoon. Looking forward to getting the pilot scheduled next week.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
